## Detailing Services Catalog (5 Core Services)
_Note: Service duration and vehicle collection depend on the selected service and the vehicle's condition. Contact Calgary Premium Auto Detailing for a personalised quotation and scheduling._

### 01. Wash — Snow Foam Wash & Decontamination
- **Professional Snow Foam Wash & Decontamination**: Contactless pH-neutral snow foam soak, two-bucket scratch-free hand wash, wheel barrel iron fallout removal, door jambs cleaning, tire satin dressing. Duration: Vehicle condition & scope dependent. Pricing: Custom quote based on vehicle size & surface condition.

### 02. PPF — Paint Protection Film (TPU Armor)
- **Self-Healing Paint Protection Film (PPF - TPU Armor)**: Optical-grade TPU rock chip, stone gravel, and scratch shield with heat-activated self-healing topcoat. Duration: Vehicle condition & scope dependent. **Included Perk: 1 Free Studio Maintenance Wash Once Every Month.** Pricing: Custom quote based on coverage package (Front Clip, High-Impact, or Full Vehicle).

### 03. Ceramic — Nano-Ceramic Coating Protection
- **Nano-Ceramic Coating Protection (SiO2 3-Year & 5-Year)**: Semi-permanent 9H nano-ceramic layer delivering extreme hydrophobicity, UV resistance, and chemical defense against coastal Mangaluru rain & salt air. Duration: Vehicle condition & scope dependent. **Included Perk: 1 Free Studio Maintenance Wash Once Every Month.** Pricing: Custom quote based on vehicle segment & warranty.

### 04. Paint — Multi-Stage Paint Correction & Polishing
- **Multi-Stage Paint Correction & Polishing**: Precision dual-action and rotary machine leveling to eliminate 85% to 95% of swirl marks, buffer trails, towel scratches, and oxidation without fillers. Includes digital paint depth audit. Duration: Vehicle condition & scope dependent. Pricing: Tailored quote following paint depth inspection.

### 05. Interior — Deep Interior Detailing & Sanitization
- **Deep Interior Detailing & Sanitization**: High-power vacuuming, hot-water / steam upholstery extraction, pH-balanced leather cleansing & UV conditioning, AC evaporator vent disinfection, germ-free deodorization. Duration: Vehicle condition & scope dependent. Pricing: Custom quote based on cabin size & stain severity.

### Complimentary Studio Audit
- **Complimentary Surface Inspection**: Free 20-minute digital paint depth gauge check, high-CRI LED swirl-finder audit, and transparent written service proposal. Complimentary (₹0 / Zero Charge).

---

## The Calgary Process (Three Stages)
1. **Stage 01 — Consultation**: Surface and paint depth audit, defect mapping, and personalized detailing protocol.
2. **Stage 02 — Execution**: Climate-timed machine correction, swirl removal, and cleanroom ceramic application in the Padil studio bay.
3. **Stage 03 — Quality Inspection**: 360-degree high-CRI inspection under multi-angle light bars before handover.

---

## Technical Architecture & Inquiry Flow
- **Framework**: React 19 SPA with TypeScript and Vite
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with custom dark mode (#0C0C0C) and Kanit Google Font
- **Customer Inquiry System**: Adaptive 5-step questionnaire capturing service category, vehicle segment (Hatchback / Sedan / Compact SUV / Full SUV / Luxury), current paint/cabin condition, Mangaluru neighborhood, and generating structured WhatsApp payloads opening to +91 97456 03303.
- **Persistence & Automation**: Local client-side storage (`calgary_customer_inquiries_v1`) with reference IDs (CLG-2026-XXXX), built-in Inquiry Tracker drawer, and modular webhook stub for future WhatsApp Business Cloud API / CRM integration.
